comment: Independent uhitm.c mhitm_ad_sitm() saddle theft from a ridden steed during monster movement. A debug-mode Knight mounts the adjacent south pony (forced), raises experience level to 14 to survive, drops the lance and food and steps back north so the pony cannot eat, then creates a hostile monkey and waits with m-prefixed searches. mhitu.c mattacku() redirects the monkey to the steed; its hit steals the saddle and dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_POLY) runs before the theft message. Spaces dismiss each --More-- and ESC closes the pile list the hero lands on.
